findings.summary: All 261 unique acquired index hrefs resolved once. All 82 ALIAS full texts were read. No acquired ALIAS is a genuinely new English article.
Canonical redirects reconstruct documentation memberships only. Article bodies and platform-specific guides remain authority for option availability.

The iPad index contains Desktop-directed links, including Presets See all -> /preset -> S600 Import & Export and Makeup See all -> /makeup-2 -> S616 Desktop Makeup. Six other Desktop section routes appear in the iPad menu. Do not inherit these articles wholesale.

53 localized indexes retain localized canonicals and are not additional English feature articles. Korean Video ALIAS0 contains generic iPad/portrait cards; Portuguese Mobile ALIAS1 and Enterprise pages contain placeholder cards. Do not treat these template lists as product-specific control guarantees.

Scanned all 93 acquired support index/ALIAS HTML files and all 240 cached API article content HTML bodies. 26 additional route candidates are preserved outside the 261 reviewed href universe: 22 possible English article URLs plus 3 malformed section links and 1 malformed Korean localized path. No new fetch or snapshot modification performed.

The camera lists in ALIAS59 resolve to S627; practical vs theoretical and Windows vs macOS conditions stay in the separate camera-matrix facts. A camera route is not a new core feature per camera and never changes device/Mac/RAW NOT_RUN.

ALIAS fetch identity and canonical S/article identity are both retained. Same title does not merge distinct Mobile/iPad/Desktop records; iPad Fuji S1531 duplicated Leica text remains a source anomaly, not Fuji proof.
Full acquired text of every ALIAS0–ALIAS81 read in batches; no truncation inherited (ALIAS49/50 were re-read after batch truncation).
